title: Outbound Growth Hunter — Business Development Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Outbound Growth Hunter — Business Development Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech

startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential

through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with

founders to deliver high-impact design solutions — from MVP design sprints to full-scale product

interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We're looking for a relentless, resourceful hunter who doesn't wait for leads to come to them.

You won't inherit a playbook — you'll write one. If you've built pipeline from scratch, found

decision-makers nobody handed you, and converted cold conversations into real opportunities,

this role is for you. Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by the chase, and sharp enough to

earn a founder's attention in three sentences or less.


You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers — primarily

founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies. You'll play a critical role in

connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

• Source qualified leads independently using any channel that works — LinkedIn,

communities, events, cold email, social, referrals, or whatever creative approach you

invent. No channel is off-limits.

• Own the full top-of-funnel — from identifying a name to booking a call — without relying

on inbound or handed leads.

• Develop and test your own outreach experiments; own the results and iterate fast.

• Find creative angles to reach founders — conference attendee lists, community posts,

funding announcements, product launches — and turn them into booked conversations.

• Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities

• Track activities and performance using CRM tools

• Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in

SaaS or agency environments)

• Proven ability to book meetings with cold prospects — share examples of creative

outreach that worked

• Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

• A track record of sourcing your own leads, not just working a provided list

• Comfortable operating without a defined system — you build your own process, manage

your own time, and hold yourself accountable to results

• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)

• Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely

• English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

• Experience selling design, product, or digital services

• Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development

• Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work to identify high-impact projects at fast-growing SaaS and tech

companies, helping shape the digital tools that empower businesses worldwide. Your

contributions will be significant in driving growth for the business, with outcomes of your efforts

making a clear impact. This is an opportunity to take the step in your career in a studio that

values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


This is not a role with rigid scripts or assigned lead lists. You'll have full creative freedom to find

and engage the right clients in whatever way works — we care only about results. If you've ever

felt constrained by a playbook, you’ll love working at Foundey.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
  • Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
  • Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
  • Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
  • Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
  • Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
  • Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.
  • Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards).
  • Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware).
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM.
  • Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce.
  • Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade.
  • Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Duotalk

A Duotalk é uma plataforma omnichannel com inteligência artificial que transforma o atendimento em conversas eficientes, escaláveis e orientadas a resultado.

Estamos construindo um produto complexo, com alta integração e impacto direto no negócio dos clientes e precisamos de pessoas que garantam qualidade real na entrega, não só organização.


Missão do cargo

Garantir que estamos construindo certo o produto, com clareza, qualidade e zero ambiguidade, atuando desde a definição até a validação final das entregas.

Você será responsável por transformar estratégia em entrega funcional, testada e confiável.


Atividades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog de produtos ou de squads complexas, atuando como um especialista.
  • Colaborar diretamente com o Product Manager na definição e refinamento da estratégia de produto.
  • Definir e comunicar as prioridades estratégicas para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar as cerimônias ágeis, garantindo que o time esteja sempre alinhado e produtivo.
  • Mentorar outros Product Owners e analistas em técnicas de gestão de backlog.
  • Conduzir o refinamento de requisitos complexos, desdobrando a visão do produto em entregas incrementais.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para dúvidas e decisões sobre o escopo do produto.
  • Acompanhar de perto as métricas de produto para validar o impacto das entregas e propor otimizações.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas junnto com o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar testes funcionais das entregas antes de produção.
  • Validar fluxos completos (não só partes isoladas).
  • Trabalhar junto com devs na validação do que foi desenvolvido.
  • Identificar inconsistências, edge cases e falhas de lógica.
  • Garantir que os critérios de aceite foram de fato atendidos.
  • Atuar como último gate de qualidade antes do release.


Hard Skills:

  • Expertise em Metodologias Ágeis e Escala: SAFe, LeSS ou outros frameworks (diferencial).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas de Gestão de Produtos: Jira, Confluence, Productboard (uso avançado).
  • Conhecimento Aprofundado em UX Research e Análise de Dados de Produto: Para embasar decisões.
  • Habilidade de prototipação (Diferencial): Para agilizar o alinhamento de ideias.
  • Noções de Arquitetura de Software: Para entender os impactos das decisões no desenvolvimento.


Soft Skills:

  • Visão Estratégica e de Negócios: Consegue conectar cada item do backlog à estratégia maior da Duotalk.
  • Liderança (sem ser gerente): Guia o time de desenvolvimento, influenciando e inspirando.
  • Habilidade de Negociação Avançada: Para balancear as necessidades de diferentes stakeholders.
  • Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Aborda dilemas de priorização e escopo com maestria.
  • Capacidade Analítica Avançada: Para usar dados e tomar decisões sobre o backlog.
  • Proatividade para Inovação: Busca novas formas de entregar valor e otimizar processos


O que oferecemos:

  • Contratação PJ;
  • 100% remoto;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento;
  • Gympass
  • Conexa Saúde
  • Optum Consultoria
  • Alura Educação

Local Business Pro is a CRM, field service management, and AI-powered communication platform built for home service businesses.


We help companies like pest control businesses, HVAC companies, electricians, plumbers, arborists, general contractors, and other service-based businesses manage their customer relationships, jobs, follow-up, scheduling, payments, and communication in one place.


Our product is also heavily focused on AI. We are building tools that help local service companies answer calls, follow up with leads, organize customer communication, and automate parts of their operations so they can grow without losing the personal touch that makes their business successful.

This is not a basic appointment-setting role.

You will be working with U.S.-based home service companies and channel partners to introduce Local Business Pro, identify gaps in their current systems, and help move qualified opportunities toward demos, onboarding, and long-term customer success.


You will also play an important role in making sure new customers are handed off properly to our Client Success team. That means setting the right expectations during the sales process, documenting customer needs, and helping ensure that every new client has a strong start after they sign up.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. AI Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
  • Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
  • Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
  • Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
  • Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
  • Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
  • Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.
  • Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards).
  • Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware).
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM.
  • Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce.
  • Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. AI Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.

  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements such as Spanish).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

4. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

5. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

6. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

7. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

Tech Lead Java

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
  • Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
  • Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
  • Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java , com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
  • Domínio de Spring Boot , incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
  • Vivência com AWS , compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful , seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
  • Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
  • Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.

  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.

Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Administramos o Clube de Alemão, a Punkify, o Vale-inglês, a SWAI e a S&W Editora, com foco em harmonia, honestidade, agilidade, inovação, resiliência, confiabilidade e inteligência. title: Analista Data Viz Sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Data Viz Sr. em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.


O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.


Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.


Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.


Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão.Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes.Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência.Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade.Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização.Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica).Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário.Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica.Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio.Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados.Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Requisitos desejáveis

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.


Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Experiência com testes e validação de dados.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

title: Desenvolvedor (a) full stack

A Hub4Pay é uma fintech brasileira especializada em soluções de pagamentos, incentivos e recompensas, criada para conectar empresas e pessoas por meio de tecnologia, eficiência e experiências relevantes. Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde cada pessoa tem espaço para experimentar, errar com responsabilidade, aprender rápido e gerar impacto real, tanto no produto quanto na vida de quem usa nossas soluções.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações com Node.js, NestJS, React.js e TypeScript;

  • Trabalhar com integrações externas, incluindo APIs financeiras, nota fiscal, clientes e usuários;
  • Apoiar práticas de CI/CD em ambientes Azure utilizando GitHub Actions;
  • Trabalhar em processos ágeis com Scrum, utilizando ferramentas como Jira para acompanhamento de demandas, bugs e discoveries;

  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA no dia a dia, como prompts, agentes, Cursor, Copilot ou similares.


Requisitos da Posição


  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência profissional no mercado de tecnologia;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento, como Cursor, Replit, Lovable, GitHub Copilot, agentes de código ou automações por prompt;
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas, com diploma de curso superior de 4 anos ou mais na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js, NestJS, React.js e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com testes unitários e de integração;
  • Conhecimento em caching, microsserviços, workers e processamento assíncrono;
  • Experiência com Azure, CI/CD e GitHub Actions;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Postman ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Scrum, ritos ágeis e ferramentas de gestão como Jira;
  • Conhecimento em SOLID, arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia técnica e capacidade de colaborar com diferentes áreas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com sistemas financeiros, preferencialmente por pelo menos 1 a 2 anos;
  • Experiência com APIs de integração financeira;
  • Experiência com nota fiscal;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de clientes e usuários;
  • Experiência com React Native para iOS e Android;
  • Conhecimento em LGPD;
  • Experiência com Azure Functions;


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho remoto;
  • VR;
  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação;
  • Ambiente colaborativo;
  • Plano de carreira;
  • Participação em projetos com impacto real no negócio.


Por que se juntar à Hub4Pay

Aqui você vai encontrar um time pequeno, técnico e altamente colaborativo, onde sua voz tem peso desde o primeiro dia. Trabalhamos com problemas reais, prazos reais e impacto mensurável, mas com a leveza de quem sabe que sustentabilidade do negócio também depende do bem-estar das pessoas.


Valorizamos quem tem inquietação saudável, gosta de fazer perguntas difíceis, defende seu ponto de vista com argumentos e está sempre disposto a aprender.

Se você se reconhece nisso e quer construir, junto com a gente, a próxima geração de soluções financeiras inteligentes, queremos te conhecer.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS , NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines.
  • Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation , ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

  • Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , RDS , EventBridge , SNS/SQS , and related AWS services.
  • Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‑Stack Development

  • Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

  • Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).
  • Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization.
  • Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations.
  • Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority.
  • Expert level AWS development experience , especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures.
  • Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).
  • Proven track record developing REST APIs , microservices, and cloud‑native applications.
  • Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs .
  • Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly.
  • Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with EventBridge , AppFlow , or enterprise iPaaS tools.
  • Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

title: Support Analyst L2 - Bilingual
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Support Analyst L2 - Bilingual em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

Please submit resumes in English. Strong English speaking and writing communication skills are required.


As a Support Analyst L2, you will troubleshoot operational issues with the Warehouse Management System (WMS), manage configurations, support cloud solutions, monitor SQL performance, and maintain documentation. You bring expertise with Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle Databases, cloud services, Linux systems, supply chain technologies, and various hardware/software tools used in warehouse and distribution operations.


What a day in the life looks like:

  • Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software.
  • Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to the ERP Vendor.
  • Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments.
  • Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of our cloud solutions.
  • SQL performance monitoring, index, and query tuning.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, troubleshooting steps, and support processes for future reference and knowledgebase articles.


What you bring to the team:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent; 5+ years of technical customer support experience.
  • 3+ years of experience with SQL/Oracle.
  • Advantage: Experience in software development.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, OCI, Google Cloud).
  • Advantage: Experience with supply chain, distribution, and interface technologies.

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de profissionais com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend para atuar na construção e evolução de aplicações robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance.

Buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, arquitetura de software e desenvolvimento de APIs, que gostem de ambientes colaborativos, desafios técnicos e evolução contínua.

A oportunidade é ideal tanto para desenvolvedores backend experientes quanto para perfis com visão mais ampla de engenharia de software e arquitetura de sistemas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend utilizando .NET Core (C#);
  • Criar e otimizar APIs e serviços escaláveis;
  • Atuar na manutenção e melhoria contínua de sistemas corporativos;
  • Participar de definições técnicas, arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares como QA, Produto, Infraestrutura e Negócio;
  • Realizar troubleshooting e análise de performance de aplicações e bancos de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade do código;
  • Apoiar processos de documentação técnica e sustentação das soluções.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET Core / C#;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e arquitetura de serviços;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente Oracle;
  • Conhecimento em Entity Framework, Dapper e LINQ;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, design patterns e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando Git ou similares;
  • Boa comunicação e atuação colaborativa em equipe.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de deploy;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes cloud (Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud);
  • Vivência com Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com observabilidade, logs e monitoramento;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Experiência em sistemas distribuídos e aplicações de alta disponibilidade.


Informações adicionais

  • Contrato: PJ
  • Remuneração: mensal fixa + benefícios
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

  • Experiência com Azure, CI/CD e GitHub Actions;

  • Conhecimento em Scrum, ritos ágeis e ferramentas de gestão como Jira;
  • Conhecimento em SOLID, arquitetura de software e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia técnica e capacidade de colaborar com diferentes áreas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com sistemas financeiros, preferencialmente por pelo menos 1 a 2 anos;

  • Experiência com React Native para iOS e Android;
  • Conhecimento em LGPD;
  • Experiência com Azure Functions;


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho remoto;
  • VR;
  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação;
  • Ambiente colaborativo;
  • Plano de carreira;
  • Participação em projetos com impacto real no negócio.


Por que se juntar à Hub4Pay

Aqui você vai encontrar um time pequeno, técnico e altamente colaborativo, onde sua voz tem peso desde o primeiro dia. Trabalhamos com problemas reais, prazos reais e impacto mensurável, mas com a leveza de quem sabe que sustentabilidade do negócio também depende do bem-estar das pessoas.


Valorizamos quem tem inquietação saudável, gosta de fazer perguntas difíceis, defende seu ponto de vista com argumentos e está sempre disposto a aprender.

Se você se reconhece nisso e quer construir, junto com a gente, a próxima geração de soluções financeiras inteligentes, queremos te conhecer.
